title: How settled an observation is
binding: a stored `status` column that kernel/fhir.py copies into Observation.status
source: The FHIR R4 published value set http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/observation-status, expanded through tx.fhir.org. R4 makes Observation.status required and this list is the whole of what it may be. `preliminary` is the one that matters here: it is R4's own word for a value that has been recorded and not yet verified, which is what a laboratory result is between the technician keying it and a second person verifying it. kernel/fhir.py published every observation as `final` until 2026-10-31, so an unverified laboratory value travelled under a patient's ABHA number as a settled one.
